$comment: Controls every visible block allows, on top of its own. block.json lists stay explicit (the server and layout tools read them as written); baseline-controls.test.ts holds every block to this list. An exception is a control the block already sets through its own setting, so allowing it too would give one value two sources. Field and Input leave out gridChild: a Field's place in the Form's grid is its Width setting, and an Input sits in its Field, which is a flex column, never a grid.
